title: Cloning the Self for Mental Well-Being: A Framework for Designing Safe and Therapeutic Self-Clone Chatbots

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative thematic analysis of semi-structured interviews with mental health professionals, evaluating the risk of Western-centric LLM outputs failing to reflect diverse cultural norms and nuances (e.g., interpretations of racism or discipline).

Qualitative thematic analysis of semi-structured interviews with mental health professionals, identifying the risks of biases stemming from Western-centric training data in underlying large language models.
